prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / illustration-story.
Edit image 1, the graphite diary illustration of three Sich Riflemen at a space-station tavern table. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and definitive style/composition reference. Images 2 and 3 are the user's Cossack HAIRSTYLE AND MOUSTACHE references ONLY: do not copy their lettering, diagrams, historical armor, or background.
Preserve image 1's warm off-white paper, authentic graphite crosshatching, soft unfinished edges, aspect ratio, lighting, room, cups, plates, food, plain functional station clothes, hand gestures and seated poses. Keep all three men's bodies and positions, and keep natural anatomy.

The user's correction: these are UKRAINIAN COSSACKS, with individual faces inspired by Ukrainian Cossack portrait traditions, visible moustaches and oseledets/chub haircuts rather than generic contemporary short-haired clean-shaven soldiers. Create a diverse, believable trio of Ukrainian men, not three identical stylized faces or ethnic caricatures. Each must look like a particular person of his own age; the natural variation and expression matter. Use the supplied Cossack hairstyle references and the following individualized portrait direction:
LEFT MAN, talking and gesturing: a lean middle-aged face, defined cheekbones, long slightly convex nose, expressive dark brows, weathered smile lines. Shaved sides and most of scalp with a single LONG Cossack oseledets growing from the crown and falling along the temple toward the ear. Prominent long drooping moustache, clean-shaven chin. Keep his attentive speaking expression and hand gesture.
CENTER MAN, holding cup: an older broad-faced veteran with fuller cheeks, a broad straight nose, deep forehead lines and thoughtful slightly tired eyes. Shaved scalp except for a long pale/silver Cossack crown lock swept to one side and tucked behind an ear, clearly identifiable, not a buzz cut or ordinary short hairstyle. A thick wide grey moustache whose ends fall gently downward. Clean-shaven chin. Keep his broad build and relaxed cup-holding pose.
RIGHT MAN, listening: a younger lean oval face, straighter finer nose, strong dark eyebrows, alert eyes, natural slight asymmetry and a subtle half-smile. Shaved sides with a substantial top forelock/chub falling FORWARD onto the forehead, as in the user's Djura reference. A shorter distinct moustache with modest upward-curving ends, clean-shaven chin. Preserve his leaning pose and folded forearms.
No full beards, no contemporary generic short haircuts, no cloned heads. The hairstyles must differ clearly in silhouette. All facial hair must look grown, not pasted on.
For any adult male background patrons whose heads are sufficiently visible, suggest varied Cossack forelocks and small moustaches with a few loose strokes; keep them faint and secondary.

Do not change the scene into a historical tavern: it is still a futuristic space-station canteen with utility jackets and bulkheads. No embroidered costumes, no vyshyvanka, no rushnyky, no sashes, no decorative waist cloth, no tassels, no flags, no blue-yellow bands, no modern Ukrainian coat of arms, no added insignia. No text, signature or watermark. No added weapons. No color or glossy digital rendering. The whole scene must still look hand-drawn in pencil by their fellow officer in his diary.
